Name: HAUST-LDV-bearing-dataset
Summary: Rolling bearing vibration signals measured without contact by laser Doppler vibrometry for healthy and pitted 6206 bearings under two load conditions.
Publisher: Henan University of Science and Technology
Description:
The HAUST-LDV-bearing-dataset, from Henan University of Science and Technology, holds vibration signals of 6206 deep groove ball bearings with several fault types. It was recorded on a precision vibration measurement platform made by SKF Österreich AG, with an AC motor, a spindle system, a pneumatic loading system and a Polytec MSL-7100 laser Doppler vibrometer that measures the radial vibration of the bearing outer ring without contact.

Two load conditions are covered: 100 N axial with no radial load, and 100 N axial with 50 N radial. For each, the set has a healthy bearing, inner and outer race pitting of 0.2, 0.3 and 0.5 mm, and roller pitting of 0.5, 0.8 and 1.0 mm, giving twenty bearing statuses. Every signal lasts 34 s at a constant 1800 rpm and is sampled at 48 kHz.

After calibration, the measurement error of the whole system is ±0.5 μm/s at 570 Hz, and the measured speed at a nominal 1800 rpm is 1804 rpm, a speed error of 0.22%.
